chunks: And from him, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Ḥabīb al-Sijistānī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: “I shall surely punish every community in Islam that professes the wilayah of every unjust Imam who is not from Allah, even if the community is righteous and pious in its deeds. And I shall surely pardon every community in Islam that professes the wilayah of every just Imam from Allah, even if the community is unjust and sinful within itself.”

key_terms.إِمَامٍ جَائِرٍ: an unjust leader who rules without divine legitimacy
key_terms.إِمَامٍ عَادِلٍ: a just Imam whose authority is from Allah
key_terms.الرَّعِيَّةُ: the subjects or community under a leader’s authority
key_terms.وِلَايَةِ: wilayah; divinely grounded authority and allegiance

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the importance of wilayah and obedience to a just Imam from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the centrality of rightful wilayah and divinely sanctioned leadership in Islam. It teaches that allegiance to an unjust ruler is a cause of punishment, while allegiance to a just Imam from Allah is a cause of divine pardon, even when personal deeds differ.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Habeeb Al Sijistany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Said: “I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Punish every citizen in Al-Islam who makes it a Religion with the guardianship of every tyrannous imam (leader) who isn’t from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and even if the citizen was righteous in his deeds, pious; and I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Forgive every citizen in Al-Islam who makes it a Religion by the Wilayah of every Just Imam<sup>asws</sup> from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and even if the citizen was unjust within himself, a sinner’.
en.sarwar: 4. He has narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Habib al-Sajistani from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, ’I will cause to suffer punishment all those who live a religious life in Islam under the guardianship of unjust Imams who possesses no authority from Allah even though such followers would be virtuous and pious in their deeds. I will forgive all those who live a religious life in Islamunder the guardianship of an Imam who is just in his dealings and possess authority from Allah even though such followers in their dealings would be unjust sinners.”
